legend: Moderately sized cells have well-defined margins and polygonal to occasionally columnar, moderate to abundant, pale cytoplasm. The cells show moderate nuclear atypia with single nucleoli and are seen singly and in small tissue fragments. Some cells have eccentric single large vacuoles containing mucin droplets. (Pap)
source: Dr Amparo Benito, Pathology Department, Hospital UNiversitario Ramon y Cajal, IRYCIS, 28034 Madrid, Spain ampario.benito@salud.madrid.org

legend: Polygonal to occasionally pulled-out pale cytoplasm and moderate nuclear atypia with single nucleoli, seen singly and in small tissue fragments. Some cells have eccentric single large vacuoles containing magenta mucinous material, and centrally there is a large pale globule that appears extracellular. (Giemsa)
source: Dr Amparo Benito, Pathology Department, Hospital UNiversitario Ramon y Cajal, IRYCIS, 28034 Madrid, Spain ampario.benito@salud.madrid.org

legend: Tissue fragments and single cells of moderate to large cells with variable often abundant pale cytoplasm, and in several cells eccentric large single vacuoles containing magenta mucin and resembling signet-ring cells. (Giemsa)
source: Dr Amparo Benito, Pathology Department, Hospital Universitario Ramon y Cajal, IRYCIS, 28034 Madrid, Spain ampario.benito@salud.madrid.org
